labels.single_gene_deletion_root_CFU: Single-gene deletion: root colony-forming unit assay
labels.author_log2FC_pooled_rice_vs_rich_medium: Author-reported log₂ fold change: pooled rice versus rich medium
labels.author_pooled_TraDIS_essentiality: Author-reported essentiality in pooled TraDIS samples
labels.measured_high_abundance_small_effect_non: Measured non-hit with sufficient abundance and a small recorded effect
labels.pooled_no_independent_replicates: Samples were pooled; independent biological replicates were not available.
labels.phenotype_cutoff_only: Classification used the recorded phenotype cutoff.
labels.hit_only_ascertainment: The available source reports selected phenotype hits rather than a complete measured background.
labels.qualified_source_evidence: Source evidence met the documented inclusion rules.
labels.negative_significant_replicates_3_of_3: Significant negative effects in 3 of 3 replicates
labels.negative_significant_replicates_2_of_3: Significant negative effects in 2 of 3 replicates
labels.negative_significant_replicates_1_of_3: Significant negative effect in 1 of 3 replicates
labels.gene_level_raw_coverage_or_valid_equival: Gene-level raw coverage or confidence intervals supporting an equivalence assessment were not available.
labels.guide_efficacy_and_valid_equivalence_CI_: Guide efficacy and confidence intervals supporting an equivalence assessment were not available. A small observed effect alone does not establish equivalence.
labels.single_replicate_endpoint_archived_not_u: The single-replicate endpoint was retained in the source archive but was not used for label qualification.
labels.gene_level_INPUT_support_not_available_i: The published results table did not provide gene-level input-library support.
labels.no_full_nonhit_background_or_per_gene_un: A complete measured non-hit background or gene-level uncertainty estimates were not available.
labels.author_shortlist_not_full_processed_fitn: The source provides an author-selected shortlist rather than a complete processed fitness table.
labels.individual_q_values_unavailable: Individual adjusted P values were not available.
labels.nonimpact_not_equivalence: A reported absence of impact is not evidence of statistical equivalence.
labels.operon_polar_effect_not_excluded: Effects on neighboring genes in the operon could not be excluded.
labels.reference_CDS_translation_not_original_M: The protein was translated from the reference coding sequence; the original MicroScope export was not available.
labels.pooled_samples_are_not_biological_replic: Pooled samples do not represent independent biological replicates.
labels.RNA_and_pseudogenes_excluded: RNA genes and pseudogenes were excluded.
labels.author_GitHub_supplement_404: The author-linked GitHub supplement was unavailable when audited.
labels.doctoral_thesis_not_journal_peer_reviewe: This evidence comes from a doctoral thesis rather than a peer-reviewed journal article.
labels.per_gene_insertion_counts_effects_and_si: Gene-level insertion counts, effect estimates and significance statistics were not available.
labels.pooled_author_essentiality_call_not_indi: The author classification comes from pooled essentiality screening and does not establish a phenotype for each host separately.
labels.positive_supported_by_only_one_significa: The positive label is supported by only one statistically significant replicate.
labels.audited_author_phenotype_without_digitiz: The author-reported phenotype was reviewed, but digitized uncertainty or replicate metadata were not available.
labels.KT2440R_marker_derivative_reference_geno: The experimental strain is a marker derivative of KT2440; sequences were mapped to the KT2440 reference genome.
labels.six_plants_not_claimed_six_independent_e: The six plants were not treated as six independent experiments.
labels.transposon_possible_polar_effect: The transposon insertion may affect neighboring gene expression.
labels.insertion_mutant_possible_polar_effect: The insertion mutation may affect neighboring gene expression.
labels.no_global_gene_effect_inference: This observation does not establish a gene effect across all conditions.
labels.complete_XML_download_unavailable: A complete machine-readable article download was not available.
labels.endpoint_day_not_imputed: An unreported measurement day was left unspecified.
labels.reviewed_primary_indexed_fulltext: The indexed primary full text was reviewed.
labels.gene_alias_reversed_in_other_sources_loc: Gene aliases differed between sources; locus and protein accession identifiers were used for mapping.
labels.phage_and_mutation_variant_conditions_no: Phage and mutation-variant conditions were not used for this label.
labels.two_independent_experiments_each_at_leas: The source reported two independent experiments, each with at least three roots.
